RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

It depends on your goal. If you want constructive feedback or to protect professional relationships, do not raise it. In structural engineering, an all-male panel often reflects senior industry demographics rather than intentional bias, and raising it directly will likely provoke defensiveness.

However, if you are considering a formal grievance or legal claim, note the composition. Affinity bias is a realistic possibility given the substantial experience gap (15 years versus 8) and reliance on subjective criteria like 'client relationships.' 

For now, do not accuse the panel. Politely follow up on your requested written explanation and document all communications before deciding whether to seek legal advice.
